findings.text: Overview's Your tasks counts My work's Assigned to me rows for WS-X90 (4) and opens that view, which lists the same 4.

My work is the one inbox: Assigned to me, Needs my approval (7 AI agent runs, the package access request), Waiting on others. AI agents' Needs approval and Review's Waiting on me send there; the bell holds mentions.
The Review queue lists every row it counts, 25 a page with working arrows (32 rows, 2 pages); the count and the rail badge are the rows listed, WS-X90's pending evidence records included.
One list of imports: Evidence › Sources shows the switch imported Aug 18 with a Nov 13 import queued; Integrations counts 6 STIG checklists in use; the checks' footnote reads the same list.
Continuous monitoring's Checks tab holds each recurring check once, with one cadence and one state (3 overdue); Schedule is its Runs tab; sources read their cadence from their check.
One Take version 2 dialog, from Host & providers; it moves Components (3 behind), Composition and its Assets, the supplier, the CVE's POA&M item (1 of 3) and the SBOM check.
Inheritance folds into Host & providers: providers, then library components; one inherited count (52), one Add provider. Boundary and Authorization list an added provider; Settings keeps the catalog.
Evidence sources is Evidence's Sources tab; Import file adds a file to that source's imports. Integrations lists connectors, with no tabs into a program's sources.
The Corporate identity provider is flagged Not authorized on Host & providers, linked to its program row, and in each control preview that leans on it.
findings.why: The Controls register's first pages show no provider column for those controls, so the flag lives in the preview and on Host & providers.

findings.text: Workspace setup is a Settings page done once; Deadlines gains Adopt proposed, which turns the 12 proposed deadlines on and ticks the step.

extra.text: Continuous monitoring's significant-change trigger names Increment 2's own IATT (due May 18, 2027) and ATO instead of SSP 3, as lane G asked.
Settings' Host systems & providers becomes the Provider catalog, its button Add to catalog, so the three add-provider dialogs read as two different acts.
Inventory is Composition's Assets tab: inventory addresses open it, and Composition's Elements and Assets share one tab strip.
The sources register gains the ASD and Evaluate-STIG checklists' sources and the failed container scan, so every import belongs to a source it lists.

walks.title: One inbox and one home for each thing

steps.do: Read the Your tasks line, then follow it.
steps.see: Your tasks 4 opens My work › Assigned to me, which lists the same 4.
steps.v2: Said 6 and opened All, which listed 13.

steps.do: Read Needs my approval; open the Evidence mapper run and choose Approve all.
steps.see: 7 AI agent runs and the package access request; the approved run leaves the list.
steps.v2: Said nothing waits on your approval.

steps.do: Page through the queue with › and ‹.
steps.see: 32 rows counted, 32 listed, 25 a page; Waiting on me opens My work's Needs my approval.

steps.do: Choose Take version 2 on Mission Computer, write a review comment, take it.
steps.see: One dialog listing what moves; afterwards version 2, AC-17(2) and SC-23 to review.
steps.v2: Three entry points; Take version 2 said Not saved.

steps.do: Look at AST-109001, then open POA&M and find the CVE's item.
steps.see: AST-109001 runs Mission Computer version 2; the POA&M item is In progress, 1 of 3.
steps.v2: Version 1 in use; the item Not started.

steps.do: Read the Checks tab and open the ACAS scan check.
steps.see: 12 checks, one cadence and state each; 2 overdue now the SBOM check passes.
steps.v2: Checks and ConMon disagreed: Overdue 4 against 2.

steps.do: Find the internal Ethernet switch; open ACAS and choose Import file.
steps.see: Switch imported Aug 18, Nov 13 import queued; the file joins ACAS's imports.
steps.v2: Switch never imported; Import file opened a 6-step wizard.

steps.do: Read the STIG Viewer and ACAS cards.
steps.see: 6 checklists in use, and ACAS counts the import just made.
steps.v2: 2 checklists; tabs jumped into the program.

steps.see: It opens Host & providers: providers, library components, Inherited 52.

steps.do: Read the flag under Providers and follow Open its program.
steps.see: The Corporate identity provider is Not authorized; its program row is PRG-1013.
steps.v2: Not authorized, never connected to anything.

steps.do: Choose Add provider and add the Integration laboratory hosting enclave.
steps.v2: It reached Overview but not Boundary.

steps.see: The added enclave is listed with its controls.

steps.do: Read the steps, then open Deadlines and choose Adopt proposed.
steps.see: 2 of 4 done; after adopting, no deadline reads Proposed and 3 of 4 are done.
